accepted_parser_patch: Use native author year,month,day for a Pico Event only when the original slash M/D/YYYY eventDate matches all three components exactly; never parse a slash-separated date range as a day or guess the orientation.
other_study_rule: Keep SãoJorge and Graciosa/Santa Maria exact ISO YYYY-MM-DD original processing unchanged.
rejection: Missing, inconsistent, nonvalid month/day/year or new URL/SHA causes strict STOP; do not impute date and do not convert unsurveyed taxa into negative observations.
confound: Field occurrences over 2019–2024 are a cross-sectional pooled observation window, not repeated standardized surveyed absences, not a current living source at an older local-loss date.
